title: Hedging and Diplomacy in Academic Discussion / Gosaa fi Safuu keessaa baafataa biraa
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessaa baafataa biraa, gosaa (hedging) miti. Kana malee, afaan Oromoo keessatti, waan hundaa’uun hin jiru, Afaan Ingilizii gara qajeelfamettii fi safuu dhuunfa qabuu barbaachisaa akka ta’ee godha. Fakkeenya, afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘Kana malees’ jedhanii waan hundaa’uun hin jiru, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘That might not be entirely accurate’ jedhaa barbaachisaa ta’e. Fakkeenyaa hojii, ‘suggest’ jedhamuudhaan afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘qajeelfama’ jechuu danda’u, garuu Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘suggest’ jedhamuudhaan qajeelfama fi wal takkaa’e dha.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessaa baafataa biraa gosaa godhu: 1) Qajeelfamoonni moddaalaa: might, may, could (fakkeenya ‘This might indicate...’). 2) Qajeelfamoonni guyyaa tokko: I would argue, I tend to think, I feel. 3) Adverbii tokko/qajeelfamoonni: perhaps, possibly, arguably, seemingly, apparently. 4) Qajeelfamoonni wal takkaa’e: suggests, indicates, implies, appears (kan ‘proves’ ammas ‘shows’ hin jiru). 5) Seentence haala dhaabachuu: it could be argued that, it seems that, one might consider. 6) Adjective haala dhaabachuu: not entirely, not necessarily, not wholly (fakkeenya ‘not entirely convincing’). 7) ‘Somewhat’, ‘rather’, ‘fairly’ jedhamuudhaan adjective haala dhaabachuu (fakkeenya ‘somewhat controversial’). 8) Kondishinal haala dhaabachuu: if this were the case, it would... Seeraa tokko: ‘must’ ammas ‘definitely’ jedhamuudhaan baafataa biraa keessatti hin amanu (dhaabataa ta’u); ‘very’ jedhamuudhaan hin godhu (kanatti ‘highly’, ‘considerably’ jechuu danda’a); fi ‘I think’ jedhamuudhaan afaan Oromoo keessatti ‘creo que’ jedhamuu miti, garuu baafataa biraa keessatti ‘I would argue’ ammas ‘It seems to me’ jechuu miti. Gaarummaa: baafataa biraa keessatti wal takkaa’e godhu (fakkeenya ‘This demonstrates...’), garuu ‘strongly suggests’ jedhamuu danda’a.

title: Nuanced Literary Analysis: Register, Tone, and Implied Meaning / Fannaan Adda Baasiqqa: Qajeelfannoo, Lafii, kan Arratti Hinargamuu
bridge: Afaan Oromo, fannaan adda baasiqqa qajeelfannoo, lafii, kan arratti hinargamuu hunda beekuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii, C1 fannaan adda baasiqqa qajeelfannoo, lafii, kan arratti hinargamuu hunda beekuu dha. Verbs modals (might, could, would), passive voice, fi vocabularies evaluative hunda beekuu dha. Afaan Oromo, 'dhaqaa' jechuun 'it is possible that...' hinjiru, Afaan Ingilizii, adverbials (arguably, ostensibly) yoo kan ta'e, verbs modals hunda beekuu dha. Afaan Ingilizii, present historic fi past perfect fannaan adda baasiqqa hunda beekuu dha.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii, fannaan adda baasiqqa C1 hunda beekuu dha:
1. **Qajeelfannoo fannaa fi akadeemikii**: Verbs *suggest, imply, illustrate, portray* hunda *show* ama *tell*, fi connectors discursives (however, moreover, consequently).
2. **Modalities fi degrees of certainty**: *Must* hunda deductions, *might/may* hunda possibilities, fi *could* hunda suggestions. Afaan Oromo, 'dhaqaa' jechuun 'The author might be trying...' ama 'Perhaps the author is trying...'.
3. **Passive voice fi passive 'it'**: hunda distancing fi objectivity (it is argued, it could be said). Afaan Oromo, 'se' impersonal hunda, Afaan Ingilizii passive hunda.
4. **Present historic**: hunda narrating events (In Chapter 3, the protagonist meets...), Afaan Oromo, present hunda, preterite hunda narrations detailed.
5. **Structures hunda purpose fi cause**: *in order to, so as to, with the aim of* vs. 'para', fi *due to, owing to* vs. 'debido a'.

title: The Art of Nuance: Hedging and Speculating / Artee Nuansa: Hedging fi Speculating
bridge: Afaan Espanii keessatti, fidhateenyaa subjunctivo fi condicional dubbatan irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’an (e.g., 'Quizás venga'). Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, nuansa kana maleesuma qabdu verb modalaal, adverb fi ‘may well’, ‘might as well’ kana ‘I dare say’ duwwan sirrii adda addaan isaanii argachuu danda’u. Akkasumas, afaan Ingilizii subjunctivo kana maleesu hin qabne yeroo hunda caalaa isaanii adkaa ta’ee ‘maybe’ barbaachisaa ta’uudha. Akkasumas, nuansa haala dhaabboluu fi haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu aduu dhiisuu wajjin tokkoo ta’e jechuu dhiisuu danda’u.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii C1 keessatti hedging fi speculating godhan: 1) Verbs modalaal haala dhaabboluu (may, might, could, should, ought to) fi haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’u. 2) Sirrii adda addaan isaanii argachuu danda’u (might have, could have) haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’u. 3) Adverbs fi phrases haala dhaabboluu: arguably, presumably, allegedly, in all likelihood, by any stretch of the imagination. 4) Hedging structures ‘I would venture to say’, ‘It stands to reason that’, ‘One might argue that’. 5) Inversion ‘should/were’ haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’u. 6) ‘Seem/appear’ followed by infinitive kana that-clause haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’u. Akkasumas, subjunctivo hin qabne; adverb qorophii isaanii haalaa hojii irra deebi’anii jiraatanii walitti dhaabboluu danda’u; ‘maybe’ caalaa ta’ee jechuu dhiisuu danda’u ‘perhaps’ kana ‘possibly’ jechuudha.

title: Nuanced Political Commentary / Fidhii sirnaa barbaachisaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, barbaachisaa siyaasii dubbii ‘kan hin taane’ jechuu akkasumas shumii ‘dha’ jechuun isaaniif adabbi isaaniif dha. Afaan Ingilizii, qorophii ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘should’ akkasumas ‘it is argued that’ akkasiif adabbi isaaniif dha. ‘It is probable that’ jechuu adabbi dha; ‘it is likely to’ jechuu akkasumas ‘it may well be that’ jechuu adabbi dha. Afaan Ingilizii, shumii ‘utterly’, ‘profoundly’, ‘slightly’ akkasiif adabbi dha, garuu afaan Oromo, shumii ‘dha’ jechuu akkasumas ‘hin taane’ jechuu adabbi dha.
rule: Barbaachisaa siyaasii danda’amte (C1) afaan Ingilizii: 1) Qorophii ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘may’, ‘should’ (e.g., ‘The policy might backfire’). 2) ‘It’ + qorophii barbaachisaa: ‘it is argued’, ‘it has been suggested’, ‘it is widely believed’. 3) Shumii ‘profound’, ‘utterly’, ‘deeply’, ‘marginally’. 4) ‘While’, ‘whereas’, ‘even though’. 5) ‘Tend to’ jechuu akkasumas ‘I would argue’, ‘It seems to me’ jechuu. ‘I think’ jechuu hin amananu; ‘should’ jechuu akkasumas modii indikiikii jechuu.

title: Narratives with Perspective / Narratiivota Afaan Ingilizii Keessatti
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessummaa, guyyaa lamaansaa qabuuf jechaa kennuuf adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, 'past simple' fi 'past continuous' hin jiru, 'past perfect' fi 'past perfect continuous' barbaachisaa ta'u malee, akkas haala dhaabachuu qabnu. Akkasumas, 'past perfect continuous' adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu, kana malee, afaan Oromo keessummaa, 'llevaba + gerundio' kana 'pluscuamperfecto' haala dhaabachuu qabnu.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti (CEFR C1), guyyaa lamaansaa qabuuf jechaa kennuuf, adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. 'Past simple' (e.g., 'she arrived') guyyaa lamaansaa qabuuf jechaa kennuuf adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. 'Past continuous' (e.g., 'she was arriving') adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. 'Past perfect' (e.g., 'she had arrived') adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. 'Past perfect continuous' (e.g., 'she had been arriving') adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu. Adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu, 'would' adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu, 'used to' adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu, fi 'might have' kana 'could have' adabbi haala dhaabachuu qabnu.

title: Advanced debate techniques / Ta’ee fi qajeelfama gochaa keessan irratti fayyadamaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessan, qajeelfama gochaa tokko tokko 'hin' jew 'kan' jiraatan, garuu afaan Ingiliffaa keessan qajeelfama gochaa fi qajeelfama deebi’aa hojiiwwan ‘while it may be true that...’, ‘even granting that...’, ‘that said...’ jedhanii miti. Afaan Ingiliffaan irra deebitan sun barbaachisaa fi hinjirtuun barbaachisaan akkas jiraatan ‘I take your point, but...’ jedhaa ‘entiendo lo que dices, pero...’ jedhuu dha. ‘Por supuesto’ jedhaman ‘of course’ jechuu qajeelfama gochaa keessan fiduu danda’a; ta’ee fi qajeelfama gochaa keessan ‘admittedly’ jew ‘granted’ jechuu dha. ‘On the contrary’ jedhaman ‘al contrario’ jedhuu qajeelfama gochaa keessan fiduu danda’a; afaan Ingiliffaa keessan qajeelfama deebi’aa hojiiwwan akka ‘in fact’ jew ‘however’ jechuu dha.
rule: Ta’ee fi qajeelfama gochaa afaan Ingiliffaa keessan irratti fayyadamuu akkasii: 1) Qajeelfama gochaa + qajeelfama deebi’aa: ‘While it is true that [X], it is also the case that [Y]’ jew ‘Even granting that [X], we must still consider [Y]’. Afaan Oromo keessan ‘hin’ jew ‘kan’ jedhee ta’e, garuu afaan Ingiliffaa keessan ‘while’ jedhaman deebi’ii hojiiwwan dha. 2) Qajeelfama deebi’aa: ‘That argument does not hold up because...’, ‘This is a fallacy of false equivalence’, ‘I dispute the premise that...’. 3) Qajeelfama gochaa: ‘I see your point, but...’, ‘Respectfully, I disagree’, ‘That may be true, but...’. ‘Yes, but’ jedhaman barbaachisaa; ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’, ‘nonetheless’ jedhaa, garuu komaa keenyaa ta’uuf ‘although’ jedhaa (komaa hin ta’in, qajeelfama gochaa keessanii wajjin). 4) Qajeelfama deebi’aa: ‘Consider the counterexample of...’, ‘This is contradicted by the fact that...’. 5) Modals qajeelfama deebi’aa: ‘That might be the case, but...’, ‘You could argue that, yet...’. Afaan Oromo keessan ‘hin’ jew ‘kan’ jedhee ta’e, garuu afaan Ingiliffaa keessan ‘however’ jedhaman deebi’ii hojiiwwan dha.

title: Navigating Academic Discourse / Maaliwwan baahima akadeemii
bridge: Afaan Oromo, maaliwwan baahima akadeemii hundaa qajeelfama tokko tokko fi qajeelfamotaan gosa gochaa barbaachisaa ta'e, garuu ingiliziffaan qajeelfamottii fi suuraa faayidaa guutuu dha. Qajeelfamottiin ‘is important that’ kana malee, ‘it is important to’ kana ‘it is crucial that’ barbaachisaadha. Ingiliziffaan akadeemii qajeelfamottiin ‘suggest’, ‘argue’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha, afaan Oromo gosa gochaa barbaachisaadha. Qajeelfamottii fi suuraa faayidaa guutuu dha, ingiliziffaan akadeemii qajeelfamottiin ‘suggest’, ‘argue’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha.
rule: Ingiliziffaan akadeemii C1 dhaabbataa: (1) Qajeelfamottiin ‘suggest’, ‘argue’, ‘maintain’, ‘contend’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha, ‘that’ + qajeelfamottiin faayidaa guutuu dha (e.g., ‘The study suggests that the effect be considered’). (2) Qajeelfamottiin ‘draw a conclusion’, ‘pose a question’, ‘address an issue’, ‘make a case’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha. (3) Qajeelfamottiin ‘furthermore’, ‘however’, ‘conversely’, ‘in light of’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha. (4) Qajeelfamottiin ‘has been argued’, ‘might be attributed to’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha. (5) Qajeelfamottiin ‘-tion’, ‘-ment’, ‘-ness’ barbaachisaa guutuu dha (e.g., ‘implementation’, ‘assessment’).

title: Idiomatic Expressions & Colloquialisms / Afaan ingilizii fi afaan isaa qajeelfama tokko tokko
bridge: Afaan Oromo, hanga waliiwwan ingiliziiwwan dhaabbataa hojii irra deebisuudha. Mana hidhaa ‘tener’ + isaan (tener hambre) irra deebisuu danda’a, ‘I have hunger’ jechuudhaan isaan gargaara; ‘I’m hungry’ jechuu miti. Afaan ingilizii qajeelfama phrasal verbs fi idiomatic expressions irra deebisuudha; akkas ilaalchisee, mana hidhaarratti walitti dhaabbataa hojii danda’u. Afaan ingilizii fi Oromootaa kanarraa miti irra deebisuu danda’a; akkasumas, pragmatics (manner of speaking) irra deebisuu danda’a; wantoota hinargamuudhaaf, qajeelfama tokko tokko qabduu danda’a.
rule: C1 level irra deebisuu danda’a, idiomatic expressions fi colloquialisms irra deebisuu danda’a. Idiomatic expressions mannaa waliiwwan tokko tokko irra hinargamuu danda’a (e.g., 'break the ice' = 'romper el hielo'). Afaan ingilizii keessumaa, waliiwwan kun verbs fi prepositions irra deebi’uu danda’a; akkasumas, kun afaan Oromootaa hinargamuudha. Waliiwwan kuni walitti dhaabbataa hojii danda’a; akkasumas, manner of speaking (register) irra deebisuu danda’a; wantoota qajeelfama (e.g., 'gonna', 'wanna') fi wantoota adabbii (e.g., 'to commence') irra deebisuu danda’a. Cultural differences irra deebisuu danda’a; British fi American English keessumaa, humor, irony, fi understatement irra deebisuu danda’a. Akkasiiwwan gargaaraa seenaa, afaan Oromootaa fi ingiliziiwwan dhaabbataa hojii danda’a.

title: Hedging and Softening Strategies for Near-Native Fluency / Faayidaa fi Baay'ee Kan Qabdu Baruuwwan Gariitiin
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, mana qabduwan ‘hojii’, ‘dha’aa’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Afaan Ingilizitti, qabduwan ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘perhaps’, ‘probably’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Qabduwan ‘I was wondering’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Akkasumas, ‘It seems like’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Qabduwan ‘I think’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. rule: Afaan Ingilizitti, faayidaa (hedging) akkasii kan qabdu: 1) Qabduwan ‘might’, ‘could’, ‘would’ (misal: ‘That might be an issue’ vs. ‘That is an issue’). 2) Qabduwan ‘perhaps’, ‘maybe’, ‘probably’, ‘apparently’, ‘as far as I know’. 3) Qabduwan ‘I was wondering if...’, ‘I'm not sure, but...’, ‘It seems to me that...’. 4) Qabduwan ‘I'd say’, ‘I tend to think’. 5) Tag questions akkasii kan qabdu: ‘..., isn't it?’ (garuu C1 keessatti baay'ee kan qabdu dhufu). Afaan Oromootti, mana qabduwan ‘I think’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Akkasumas, ‘I believe’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha. Akkasumas, ‘I think’ jechuunis akkas jechuu dha.
